resources.title: Pipeline Troubleshooting Checklist
resources.description: A real diagnostic sequence for "a pipeline reports Failed" or, trickier, "a pipeline reports Succeeded but didn't do what it should have": drill from the Monitor hub's pipeline-run status into activity runs, read the failure type before the raw exception text, and the specific Try-Catch-vs-Do-If-Else distinction that explains why a failed activity doesn't always turn the whole pipeline red.

resources.title: Trigger Type Decision Guide
resources.description: A decision table for Schedule vs. Tumbling Window vs. Event-Based triggers — backfill support, retry behavior, concurrency limits, and the one-to-one vs. many-to-many pipeline relationship each one has — plus what maxConcurrency actually controls during a large backfill, so a slow-draining queue of windows doesn't get mistaken for a broken trigger.

resources.title: Pipeline-From-Requirements Planning Template
resources.description: A fill-in-the-blanks template for turning a stakeholder ask into a buildable pipeline spec before opening Data Factory Studio: source/sink, schedule, error-handling shape (Try-Catch vs. Do-If-Else), secrets handling, and an explicit requirement-to-activity traceability table — the same scoping discipline the course's own capstone uses, generalized for any new pipeline request.

resources.title: Data Project Review Rubric
resources.description: A five-dimension rubric (correctness, testing, documentation, performance awareness, maintainability) for reviewing a finished pipeline against a real professional standard. Shared across the Analytics Engineer path's courses.
